CalibrationProfile.title: CalibrationProfile
CalibrationProfile.description: Device-tagged 5-point + 4-point validated eye-tracking affine regression profile owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

deviceModel.description: Android Build.MODEL identifier for camera geometry matching (1 to 80 chars).

matrixCoeffs.description: 12-element flattened 2x6 regularized least-squares regression matrix mapping standardized [1, gx, gy, yaw, pitch, roll+distance] to normalized screen (x, y).

baselineEyeDistancePx.description: Reference inter-ocular pixel distance measured during calibration.

meanErrorMm.description: Held-out 4-point validation approximate mean Euclidean error in millimeters.

meanErrorPct.description: Held-out 4-point validation mean Euclidean error as percentage of screen.

maxErrorPct.description: Held-out 4-point validation worst-quadrant error as percentage of screen.

closeBlinkThreshold.description: Lower Schmitt-trigger eye-open probability threshold for blink start.

openBlinkThreshold.description: Upper Schmitt-trigger eye-open probability threshold for blink end.

intentionalBlinkMinMs.description: Minimum eye closure duration in milliseconds for an intentional command blink (default 350 ms; natural blink is 80-349 ms).

isActive.description: Whether this profile is currently active.

TrackingSession.title: TrackingSession
TrackingSession.description: Recorded section-level screen attention and blink telemetry session owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

title.description: Title of the reading passage or control deck session (1 to 120 chars).

naturalBlinkCount.description: Count of natural involuntary blinks (80-349 ms).

intentionalBlinkCount.description: Count of intentional command blinks (350-900 ms).

effectiveWordsPerMinute.description: Passage word count divided by active reading time in minutes.

fixationClusterCount.description: Count of dispersion-grouped coarse fixation centroids.

topZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in top screen third (0-100).

middleZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in middle screen third (0-100).

bottomZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in bottom screen third (0-100).

sectionLoads.description: Bounded list (max 12) of section dwell summary strings (e.g. 'sec_1:Intro:42').

clusterPoints.description: Bounded list (max 40) of coarse fixation cluster strings encoded as 'x,y,dwellMs'.

/users/{userId}/calibrations/{profileId}.description: User-scoped calibration profiles containing standardized 2x6 regression matrices and held-out validation metrics (mean and worst-quadrant).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-scoped eye tracking and section attention analytics sessions.
